5105: Everyone simply calls him "Hachi" (Japanese for "eight" or "eighth") or "Hachimaki"; because he wears one during his EVAs).

7593: The contracted office employee and the only one in the Debris Section office to ever be seen consistently doing any office work. Has been previously married.
7594: The Supervisor assistant of the Debris Section. He is survived by his wife seven kids, who live in his homeland, India.
7595: Assistant section manager for Debris Section. Called 'sachou' (meaning 'chief') thoughout the series. He believes he is good for nothing. He is very fond of crisps and cakes.

7599: The CEO of the Jupiter Mission and Chief Designer of the Von Braun Jupiter Exploration Spacecraft. Seemingly cold and heartless, he is portrayed in the anime and manga as someone without sympathy and believes that the ends justify the means.
